citation: EPA 542-F-15-009, April 2015, Climate Change Adaptation Technical Fact Sheet: Contaminated Sediment Remedies
supports: The regulator's own definition of a reactive cap names activated carbon mats. No novelty is available for a sorbent mat used as a sediment cap.
does_not_support: Any claim about our specific chemistry, our retrievability, or European regulatory acceptance.
verbatim: In a reactive cap, the isolation layer includes an amendment (such as organoclay or activated carbon mats) that binds or sequesters contaminants exiting the sediment pore water, thereby preventing contaminant release to surface water.

organisation: CETCO / Minerals Technologies Inc., Lovell, Wyoming, USA
citation: REACTIVE CORE MAT with ORGANOCLAY technical data sheet, form TDS_RCM_ORGANOCLAY_AM_EN_201705_V2, updated May 2017
supports: A permeable geotextile composite carrying 0.8 lb/ft2 (about 3.9 kg/m2) of granular organoclay, hydraulic conductivity 1e-3 cm/s minimum (1e-5 m/s), sold for in situ subaqueous capping since at least 2017. Our config.py assumes 4.0 kg/m2 of medium, essentially the same areal loading.
does_not_support: Retrieval or replacement of a laid mat: the data sheet says nothing about it, in either direction.
verbatim: ORGANOCLAY REACTIVE CORE MAT is a permeable composite of geotextiles and granular Organoclay that reliably adsorbs NAPL and low solubility organics from water.

organisation: HUESKER (page retrieved: HUESKER Inc., Charlotte, North Carolina, USA; page states group headquarters in Germany)
citation: Tektoseal Active for Heavy Metals, product family page
supports: A geotextile composite with an internal active layer specifically for heavy metals, using a cation adsorber or zeolite, listed for isolation of contaminated sediments including underwater. Stated laboratory binding capacity above 200,000 mg/m2, which is 0.2 kg/m2.
does_not_support: Our capacity assumptions. Ours are about 83 times smaller for Pb and 310 times smaller for Hg, deliberately, so breakthrough is visible in six years. The comparison must never be presented in our favour.
verbatim: more than 200,000 mg of metals and radionuclides can be bound per m2

supports: A competing granular composite delivery form for the same amendments, including powdered activated carbon, organoclay, clinoptilolite, zero-valent iron, sulfur compounds and Methylation Inhibitors. A vendor selling a methylation inhibitor confirms that methylmercury under an amendment is a recognised operational problem.
does_not_support: Any performance number for our mat.
verbatim: AquaGate+ delivers powdered amendments in a thin coating around an inner core, allowing movement of water through the matrix for treatment, while limiting the migration of contaminants.

citation: In situ sediment treatment using activated carbon: a demonstrated sediment cleanup technology, Integrated Environmental Assessment and Management 11(2):195-207, 2015
supports: Scale of prior deployment: more than 25 field-scale demonstrations or full-scale projects through 2013 in the United States, Norway and the Netherlands. Names SediMite and AquaGate as existing engineered delivery products.
does_not_support: Efficacy for Pb or Hg specifically; the field record is dominated by hydrophobic organics.
verbatim: Through 2013, however, more than 25 field-scale demonstrations or full-scale projects spanning a range of environmental conditions were completed or underway in the United States, Norway, and the Netherlands.

organisation: Samuelsson, G.S., Raymond, C., Agrenius, S., Schaanning, M., Cornelissen, G., Gunnarsson, J.S.
citation: Response of marine benthic fauna to thin-layer capping with activated carbon in a large-scale field experiment in the Grenland fjords, Norway, Environmental Science and Pollution Research 24(16):14218-14233, 2017, DOI 10.1007/s11356-017-8851-6
supports: European field-scale evidence: 100x100 m plots at 30 m depth and a 200x200 m plot at 95 m depth; achieved cap thickness 11 +/- 6 and 12 +/- 3 mm after one month; AC at a 1:10 dry-weight ratio with clay; 2 per cent AC by sediment dry weight after nine months; abundance, biomass and species number reduced by up to 90 per cent.
does_not_support: Any claim that a thin cap achieves its design thickness uniformly. It did not.
verbatim: The achieved thickness of the caps were after 1 month measured to 11 +/- 6 and 12 +/- 3 mm for AC+clay-30 and AC+clay-95 respectively.

organisation: Raymond, C., Samuelsson, G.S., Agrenius, S., Schaanning, M.T., Gunnarsson, J.S.
citation: Impaired benthic macrofauna function 4 years after sediment capping with activated carbon in the Grenland fjords, Norway, Environmental Science and Pollution Research 28(13):16181-16197, 2020, DOI 10.1007/s11356-020-11607-0
supports: Two things at once. Physical: up to 75 per cent of the applied activated carbon was lost to surrounding areas during placement by lateral advection, which is degradation mode 3 observed at field scale and at time zero. Ecological: species diversity, abundance and biomass reduced by up to 90 per cent, particle reworking and bioirrigation reduced, effects still present at 49 months.
does_not_support: Any statement that capping is ecologically safe.
verbatim: These long-lasting negative ecological effects should be carefully considered before decisions are made on sediment remediation with powdered AC, especially in large areas, since important ecosystem functions can be impaired.

organisation: Reible, D., University of Texas at Austin
citation: In-situ management of contaminated sediments: capping and in-situ treatment, NORDROCS, 2012
supports: Three things. (1) A thin reactive core mat ranks SECOND of three remedial forms on performance, behind a strong sorbent mixed throughout a cap layer. (2) Site water fouls activated carbon: sorption reduced by about half an order of magnitude at 14 mg/L dissolved organic carbon. (3) Tidally controlled upwelling is a recognised transport process through a cap, justifying the Darcy velocity term in our layer equations.
does_not_support: Any claim that a thin mat outperforms a thick amended cap.
verbatim: In general, strong sorbents mixed throughout a cap layer provides the best performance in sediment remedies. Less effective, although still quite effective is a layer of sorbent mixed within a thin layer (e.g. in a reactive core mat) as part of the cap.

citation: An analytical modeling approach for evaluation of capping of contaminated sediments, Soil and Sediment Contamination 18:470-488, 2009
supports: Prior analytical cap models with advection, diffusion and sorption. The companion numerical model CAPSIM (Reible and Lampert, 2012) already includes consolidation, deposition, nonlinear sorption, bioturbation, colloidal transport and boundary layer mass transfer resistances.
does_not_support: Any claim that our model is novel, or more complete. CAPSIM contains more physics than our layer does.
verbatim: Lampert D, Reible DD. 2009. An analytical modeling approach for evaluation of capping of contaminated sediments. Soil Sediment Contam 18:470-488.

organisation: Johnson, N.W., Reible, D.D., Katz, L.E.
citation: Biogeochemical Changes and Mercury Methylation beneath an In-Situ Sediment Cap, Environmental Science and Technology 44(19):7280-7286, 2010, DOI 10.1021/es100161p
supports: The mechanism by which capping can INCREASE methylmercury: an upward extension of anaerobic bacterial activity beneath a cap. Search-index summaries report an increase of up to about 50 per cent in a zone 2 to 3 cm higher than in uncapped sediment.
does_not_support: The numbers. They are NOT verbatim-verified. Do not put them on a chart until the article is obtained.

citation: Activated Carbon Mitigates Mercury and Methylmercury Bioavailability in Contaminated Sediments, Environmental Science and Technology 47(22), 2013, DOI 10.1021/es4021074
supports: The opposite direction: activated carbon and a thiol-functionalised mesoporous silica (Thiol-SAMMS), at 2 to 7 per cent of sediment dry weight, reduced porewater methylmercury by 45 to 95 per cent. Also independent evidence that the thiol route is real in a sediment context.
does_not_support: A thin overlying mat. These are amendments mixed INTO sediment at bulk doses, a different geometry from ours.

organisation: Bessinger, B.A., Vlassopoulos, D., Serrano, S., O'Day, P.A.
citation: Reactive transport modeling of subaqueous sediment caps and implications for the long-term fate of arsenic, mercury, and methylmercury, Aquatic Geochemistry 18(4):297-326, 2012, DOI 10.1007/s10498-012-9165-4
supports: Methylmercury formation is predicted inside the cap itself, and the worst dissolved methylmercury outcome is tied to advecting porewater in an estuarine setting, which is exactly the regime our demonstrator runs in. Favourable outcomes are predicted only after 5 to 10 years of sulfide build-up, which is beyond our 1 to 6 year window.
does_not_support: Treating a linear isotherm as adequate for mercury. Mercury in a cap is sulfide-controlled.
verbatim: Methylmercury formation is predicted to occur within the upper 0.15 m of the cap in both estuarine and freshwater scenarios.

citation: Electroanalytical Trace Metal Cations Quantification and Speciation in Freshwaters: Historical Overview, Critical Review of the Last Five Years and Road Map for Developing Dynamic Speciation Field Measurements, Molecules 28(6):2831, 2023, DOI 10.3390/molecules28062831
supports: The commercial history of the VIP probe, the distinction between mercury as electrode material and mercury as analyte, and the statement that VIP/TracMetal perform well in seawater or estuarine conditions.
does_not_support: Current orderability of any instrument. It is a review, not a catalogue.
verbatim: Both the GIME and the proposed online oxygen removal were used in the development of the most successful ASV field probe named the 'Voltammetric in situ profiling system' (VIP), which has been developed by Geneva University and commercialized by Idronaut for more than two decades.

citation: Convention for the Protection of the Marine Environment of the North-East Atlantic, 1992, Annex II Article 5
supports: Laying a reactive mat on the seabed in the OSPAR maritime area requires authorisation by the competent national authority. Retrievability is a regulatory argument as well as an engineering one.
does_not_support: Any assumption that a demonstration implies a permit, or that OSPAR is the whole regulatory picture: the London Convention and Protocol form a parallel regime.
verbatim: No placement of matter in the maritime area for a purpose other than that for which it was originally designed or constructed shall take place without authorisation or regulation by the competent authority of the relevant Contracting Party.

citation: Technological and policy solutions for the management of contaminated sediments in the EU
supports: EU legal frameworks for sediment are fragmented, no EU-wide sediment-specific environmental quality standards exist, and dredging and capping are expensive and cannot be applied everywhere. That is the honest motivation for a cheaper, serviceable option.
does_not_support: Any European acceptance criterion. There is no single one to be scored against, so every threshold in PolicyConfig is a demonstration trigger.
verbatim: the current legal frameworks are fragmented across the EU, and Member States address the challenges with diverging approaches

organisation: Palermo, M., Maynord, S., Miller, J., Reible, D. / US EPA Great Lakes National Program Office
citation: Guidance for In-Situ Subaqueous Capping of Contaminated Sediments, EPA 905-B96-004, ARCS Program, 1998
supports: The canonical dated origin of in-situ capping design guidance, establishing that this is nineteen-nineties technology.
does_not_support: Anything textual. Only the bibliographic identity is verified.

citation: Intelligent sediment-groundwater digital twin: A systematic review, meta-analysis, and reference architecture for reliable metal pollution risk assessment, PII S0048969726006170, PMID 42361392, 2026
supports: That sensor-informed state estimation and data assimilation for sediment and groundwater metal pollution is an established, reviewed field as of 2026. We may not present it as new.
does_not_support: Its contents. Only the existence and identity of the review are verified. A reported pooled out-of-sample R2 of 0.67 is SEARCH_INDEX_ONLY and unverified. The PubMed page served only a cookie notice on the access date.
